parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The collection page number.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Limit events to those starting after the specified date.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Limit events to those ending before the specified date.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Limit result set to events assigned specific categories.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Limit result set to events assigned specific tags.

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Limit result set to events assigned to specific venues.

parameters.description: Limit result set to events assigned to specific organizers.

parameters.name: featured
parameters.description: Limit result set to featured events only.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Limit result set to events with specific status.

parameters.name: post_parent
parameters.description: Limit result set to events with specific post parent.

parameters.name: starts_before
parameters.description: Limit result set to events starting before the specified date.

parameters.name: starts_after
parameters.description: Limit result set to events starting after the specified date.

parameters.name: ends_before
parameters.description: Limit result set to events ending before the specified date.

parameters.name: ends_after
parameters.description: Limit result set to events ending after the specified date.

parameters.name: ticketed
parameters.description: Limit result set to events with tickets.

parameters.name: orderby
parameters.description: Sort collection by event attribute.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

parameters.name: geoloc_lat
parameters.description: The latitude of the event

parameters.name: geoloc_lng
parameters.description: The longitude of the event

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: The distance of the events relative to the geolocation

parameters.name: has_geoloc
parameters.description: Filter by events that have geolocation data

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: Filter by events near an address

parameters.name: in_series
parameters.description: Filter by events that are part of a series

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Filter by events that are part of specified series IDs

parameters.name: related_to
parameters.description: Filter by events that are related to a specific event ID.

parameters.name: recurring
parameters.description: Filter by events that are recurring

parameters.name: virtual
parameters.description: Filter by events that are virtual

Link.description:
RFC 5988 Link header for pagination. Contains navigation links with relationships:
				`rel="next"` for the next page (if not on last page),
				`rel="prev"` for the previous page (if not on first page).
				Header is omitted entirely if there's only one page
